categories.name: Orders & shipping
categories.description: Delivery times, tracking and changes to your order.

articles.title: How long does delivery take?
articles.html:
Most orders leave our warehouse within one business day. Once your parcel is on its way, these are the usual delivery times:

  • United States: 2 business days with standard shipping.
  • Canada: 4 to 7 business days.
  • European Union and the UK: 3 to 5 business days.
  • Rest of the world: 5 to 10 business days.

Free shipping

Shipping is free on orders over $75 in the United States and the EU, and on orders over $150 to Canada. Below that, standard shipping costs $6.

Need it sooner? Express delivery (next business day in the US) is available at checkout for $18.

articles.title: How do I track my order?
articles.html:
As soon as your order is packed, we send a shipping email with a tracking link. It usually arrives within an hour of the parcel leaving our warehouse.

Your order number starts with SB- (for example SB-48211). You can also see the tracking status any time under Account > Orders.

Tracking says "Label created"

That status means the carrier has your parcel's label but has not scanned it yet. Sometimes the first scan is missed and the next update only appears at the sorting facility, a day or two later. If your tracking has not moved for 3 business days, message us in the chat with your order number and we will check with the carrier.

articles.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
articles.html:
We start packing quickly, so changes are possible for one hour after you place your order.

  • To change a size, color or the shipping address, message us in the chat with your order number.
  • To cancel, do the same and we will refund the full amount to your original payment method.

If your order has already shipped, you can still return or exchange it for free within 30 days once it arrives.

articles.title: Do you ship internationally?
articles.html:
Yes, we ship to more than 40 countries, including the United States, Canada, the UK, every EU country, Switzerland, Norway, Australia and Japan.

Prices at checkout include VAT for EU and UK orders, so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery. For other countries, import duties may be charged by your local customs office.

categories.name: Returns & exchanges
categories.description: 30-day returns, free size exchanges and refunds.

articles.title: Returns and refunds
articles.html:
You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery.

  1. Go to Account > Orders and choose Start a return.
  2. Print the prepaid label, or show the QR code at a drop-off point.
  3. Pack the item in its original packaging and drop it off.

Once the parcel reaches our warehouse we inspect it, usually within two business days. Your refund then goes back to your original payment method and appears within 3 to 5 business days.

Returns are free in the United States and the EU. Gift cards and personalized items cannot be returned.

articles.title: Exchanging for a different size
articles.html:
Wrong size? Size exchanges are free for 30 days, both ways.

  1. Go to Account > Orders and choose Start a return.
  2. Pick Exchange for different size and choose the new size.
  3. We ship the new size as soon as your return is scanned by the carrier, so you do not have to wait for it to reach us.

If the size you want is out of stock, we will let you know and refund the item instead.

articles.title: My return was flagged for review
articles.html:
Every return is checked by a person in our warehouse. If something looks off, for example a mark on a jacket or signs of wear on a sole, the return is flagged for a second look before we refund it.

Most flags are cleared the same day. If yours has been waiting for more than two business days, message us in the chat with your order number and a member of our team will check it right away.

categories.name: Products & care
categories.description: Sizing, leather care, warranty and gear advice.

articles.title: Find your size: running shoes and boots
articles.html:
All our footwear uses EU sizes from 36 to 47.

  • Tempo Stability Running Shoe: runs half a size small in the toe box. We recommend going up half a size.
  • Alpine Trail Boot: true to size, and available in regular, narrow and wide widths. If one foot is narrower than the other, choose the narrow width and add an insole on the wider side.
  • Trailrunner Mid: true to size with a roomy toe box.

Measure your foot in the evening, when it is at its largest, and compare it with the size chart on each product page. Not sure? Exchanges are free for 30 days.

articles.title: Caring for your leather
articles.html:
Our bags, wallets and card holders are made from full-grain, vegetable-tanned leather. It darkens and softens with use, which is part of its charm.

  • Wipe off dust with a soft, dry cloth.
  • Condition the leather every 3 to 6 months with a neutral leather balm.
  • If it gets wet, let it dry slowly at room temperature, away from radiators.
  • Small scratches can usually be rubbed out with your thumb.

articles.title: Our 3-year leather warranty
articles.html:
Every Solbay leather product comes with a 3-year warranty on stitching and hardware. If a seam opens or a buckle breaks in normal use, we repair or replace it for free.

To make a claim, message us in the chat with your order number and a photo of the problem. The warranty does not cover normal wear such as scratches or color changes, but our repair service can often help with those too.

articles.title: Which backpack is right for me?
articles.html:
• Ridge 32 Hiking Backpack: 32 litres, the sweet spot for hut-to-hut trips where you do not carry a tent or food. Its mesh back panel is our best for warm days, and it has a sleeve and hose routing for a 3-litre water reservoir.
  • Ridge 20 Daypack: 20 litres for city days and short trails, with a padded 14-inch laptop sleeve.
  • Heritage Canvas Rucksack: 24 litres of waxed canvas and leather, made for everyday carry rather than mountains.

articles.title: Gift wrapping and gift notes
articles.html:
Gift wrapping is free. Tick Gift wrap at checkout and add a handwritten note; we write it by hand on a Solbay card.

You can send each item to a different address: choose the shipping address per item at checkout. Prices are never included in a gift parcel.

articles.title: Payment methods
articles.html:
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. In the EU you can also pay in three instalments with Klarna.

Your card is charged when your order ships, not when you place it.

articles.title: Wholesale and stockists
articles.html:
We work with a small number of independent shops and concept stores. Wholesale orders start at EUR 1,500, and reorders have no minimum.

To apply, use the Wholesale inquiry form in the chat or write to our wholesale team. We will send our current line sheet, wholesale prices and lead times, which are usually 2 to 3 weeks for the leather collection.
